n. a group of words that form a constituent of a sentence and are considered as a single unit
n. the creation of a construct; the process of combining ideas into a congruous object of thought
n. drawing a figure satisfying certain conditions as part of solving a problem or proving a theorem
construction.translation:
n. 建筑, 构造, 建筑物
[化] 施工

construction account.translation: [经] 建筑帐户, 基建帐户

construction budget.translation: [经] 基建预算, 建筑预算

construction contract.translation: [经] 施工合同, 工程建设合同

construction cost.translation: [化] 工程费; 建设费用; 建造成本; 建筑费

construction engineering.translation:
[化] 结构工程
[经] 建筑工程

construction expenditure special.translation: [经] 专项工程支出, 工程支出特别基金

construction in process.translation: [经] 未完基建工程, 在建工程

construction other than buildings.translation: [经] 房屋建筑物外的其他基建

construction phase.translation:
[化] 建设阶段
[经] 建设阶段

construction work-in-process.translation: [经] 在建工程, 未完基建工程

constructional.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or deduced from, construction or
   interpretation.
constructional.translation: a. 建造的, 构造的, 解释的

constructional detail.translation: [化] 结构图; 构造图; 详图

constructionism.translation: [数]构造论； (美学)构成主义； 构成派

constructionist.definition:
n. One who puts a certain construction upon some
   writing or instrument, as the Constitutions of the United States; as, a
   strict constructionist; a broad constructionist.
constructionist.translation:
n. 构成派造型艺术家, 宪法解释者
[法] 对宪法等成文法作解释的人

constructionists.definition:
plural of constructionist
n. One who puts a certain construction upon some
   writing or instrument, as the Constitutions of the United States; as, a
   strict constructionist; a broad constructionist.
constructionists.translation:
(constructionist 的复数) n. 构成派造型艺术家, 宪法解释者
[法] 对宪法等成文法作解释的人

constructions.definition:
n the act of constructing something
n a group of words that form a constituent of a sentence and are considered as a single unit
n the creation of a construct; the process of combining ideas into a congruous object of thought
n a thing constructed; a complex entity constructed of many parts
n drawing a figure satisfying certain conditions as part of solving a problem or proving a theorem
n an interpretation of a text or action
n the commercial activity involved in repairing old structures or constructing new ones
constructions.translation: n. 构造学；建筑物；建设（construction的复数）

constructive.definition:
a. constructing or tending to construct or improve or promote development
s. emphasizing what is laudable or hopeful or to the good
constructive.translation:
a. 建设性的, 构造上的
[医] 构成的

constructive abandonment.translation: [法] 推定遗弃, 推定抛弃

constructive closing.translation: [经] 推定结帐, 视同结帐, 构成结帐

constructive delivery.translation: [经] 推定交货, 构成交货

constructive dismissal.translation: [法] 推定驳回, 推定解雇

constructive metabolism.translation: [医] 合成代谢, 组成代谢

constructive receipt.translation: [经] 推定收入, 推定已获未收收入

constructive total loss.translation: [经] 推定全部损失, 构成全部损失

constructiveness.definition:
n. Tendency or ability to form or construct.
n. The faculty which enables one to construct, as in
   mechanical, artistic, or literary matters.

constructivism.definition: n. an abstractionist artistic movement in Russia after World War I; industrial materials were used to construct nonrepresentational objects
constructivism.translation: n. 构成主义, 构成派舞美艺术

constructivist.definition: n. an artist of the school of constructivism
constructivist.translation: n. 构成派造型艺术家

constructivists.definition:
plural of constructivist
n. an artist of the school of constructivism
constructivists.translation: (constructivist 的复数) n. 构成派造型艺术家

constructor.definition: n someone who contracts for and supervises construction (as of a building)
constructor.translation:
n. 建造者, 造船技师
[计] 结构符, 构造符, 构造器, 构造程序, 构造操作

constructors.definition: n someone who contracts for and supervises construction (as of a building)
constructors.translation: n. 构造器；构造函数；建构式；施工人员（constructor的复数形式）

constructs.definition:
n an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
v make by combining materials and parts
v put together out of artificial or natural components or parts; He manufactured a popular cereal"
v draw with suitable instruments and under specified conditions
v create by linking linguistic units
v create by organizing and linking ideas, arguments, or concepts
v reassemble mentally
constructs.translation: n. 构图；建筑物；构念（construct的复数）

construe.definition: v make sense of; assign a meaning to
construe.translation:
vt. 解释, 分析, 对...逐字直译
vi. 作句法分析
n. 直译

construed.translation: v. 解释（陈述、行为等）( construe的过去式和过去分词 ); 翻译, 作句法分析

construes.definition: v make sense of; assign a meaning to
construes.translation: v. 解释（陈述、行为等）( construe的第三人称单数 ); 翻译, 作句法分析

construing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Construe
construing.translation: v. 解释（陈述、行为等）( construe的现在分词 ); 翻译, 作句法分析

consts.translation: (const 的复数) n. 常量, 常数
